title: Earth-shape models behind GPS
summary: At the US Navy's Dahlgren lab, Gladys West programmed and modelled the precise shape of the Earth from satellite data; her geodesy models were later built into GPS.
why: Without an accurate Earth model, GPS would be useless for navigation.

unsung.contribution: Built mathematical models of Earth's shape from satellite data that were incorporated into GPS.
unsung.recognition: Her role became widely known only after a sorority member read her biography; Air Force Hall of Fame in 2018.
